I had a pretty strict stepdad growing up and there were 3 things he loved. Hockey. Sailing. Motorcycles. One day he went out to the garage getting ready to ride his newly purchased Motoguzi bike. I would always wait for the sound of him leaving just so I could breathe for a few hours. Never heard the bike start. Didn’t hear him come back inside. I did, however, hear a man yell a few obscenities and my name was mixed in there somewhere. Apparently there was a giant scratch on his bike that only my pedal bike could have made. I denied.
